dialog.title: {project_name} {version}
dialog.heading: Spread overdue review cards
dialog.description: Select decks, choose a time range, preview the result, and then move only the next due dates of overdue review cards.
decks.show_only_due: Show only decks with due reviews
settings.start_after_help: Use 0 to start today, 1 to start tomorrow, 2 for the day after tomorrow, and so on. The date picker and the day number stay in sync.
settings.card_order_help: By default, cards are spread in their current due order, so the oldest overdue cards are placed earlier in the new schedule.
summary.no_cards: No due review cards found in selected decks.
preview.title: Preview schedule
preview.heading: Preview
preview.description: This is a preview only. No cards are changed from this window.
errors.title: {project_name}
errors.no_decks: Select at least one deck first.
errors.no_cards: No due review cards were found in the selected decks.
errors.invalid_days: Spread over days must be at least 1.
errors.invalid_start: Start after days must be 0 or greater.
confirm.title: Confirm reschedule
confirm.body: You have selected {count} due review cards. They will be distributed across {days} days, starting {start_label}, using {distribution}. Only the cards' next due dates will be changed. Continue?
confirm.large_warning: This is a large change. Make sure you have a backup or a recent sync.
result.title: Done
result.body: Rescheduled {count} due review cards across {days} days, starting {start_label}.
settings.distribution_help: Even keeps the current linear behaviour. Front-loaded puts more moved cards near the beginning, back-loaded puts more near the end, and bell curve puts more near the middle. Higher strength makes the curve stronger.
preview.summary: Total moved cards: {total} | Days: {days} | Min: {min_count}/day | Max: {max_count}/day | Average: {average}/day
preview.load_help: Load is relative to the busiest day in this preview. It shows only the cards moved by this operation.
